sam: quick check 926-03-24 run that needs short burst of GPUs for a 90m inference smoke. targeting 6 H100 in us-west1. anyone seeing quota issues?
maya: us-west1 quota shows 2 free right now. we can borrow 4 from demo-standby if procurement ok.
liam: vendor probe: us-west1 H100 immediate availability: 10, but cloud quota requires approval for +4. opened ticket #4621.
procurement-bot: PO 812 created, awaiting finance approval. please include expected spend and duration.
sam: cost estimate ~ $70/hr for 6 nodes, total ~ $105 for 90m. sending justification now.
maya: FYI i pushed a tiny TF toggle to prefer `demo-standby` when `pool.available < desired`. link: https://git.redwood.internal/r/infra/pulls/1452
deploy-bot: scheduled short-canary: https://deploy.redwood.internal/canaries/2026-03-24/short-burst-us-west1 run c-9901
liam: cloud support replied: quota bump pending, ETA 4h. if not approved we fallback to 2 H100 us-west1 + 4 A100 in us-east2 with routing policy `spill_to_remote=true`.
sam: noted. i'll proceed with canary in us-west1 and confirm when PO clears. thanks all.
